observation.description: 32-inch dimmable LED under-cabinet light; ideal for illuminating counters to create more usable work space or a relaxed atmosphere 3 color temperatures (3000k, 4000k, and 5000k) via a user-friendly touch switch; 3-level dimming (0, 50%, and 100%) via a rocker switch; 14 watts; 1100 lm @ 3000k; energy efficient High color rendering index (CRI > 90), similar to sunlight; meets UL and FCC safety standards Direct wire installation; splicing function; linkable with additional units (sizes include 12, 18, 24, and 32 inches; additional units sold separately) Made of durable plastic and metal with a white finish; measures 32 inches long; backed by an Vovex 1-year limited warranty

Includes 1 LED vintage-style bulb
